title: Private Ballot
summary: Run non-binding voting pilots in a hosted staging app, with verifiable archives and optional Ootle mainnet anchoring. November 25, 2026: current README revision fa5597f identifies the live hosted staging site and a November 23 mainnet anchor. Trusted text extraction reached its Home page and the official indexer-b durable receipt for transaction 28c789e60e696a4bcfe56a4b9ff3b6b69d4c1d38deebe71273e18a80a2bf01f2; both indexers report mainnet. The creator’s report binds this receipt to the existing V2 template. The separate transaction-result extraction failed, so this review does not independently replay or certify the creator’s full execution verification. Staging is for non-binding pilots only; hosted mode exposes more network metadata than Desktop/Tor. The production hostname is not deployed. The creator reports Sapient qualification; live Tari Universe qualification and a new release-qualified desktop installer remain outstanding. The recording is a README walkthrough, not an election or wallet demonstration.
